q1.q: How do I create my first session?
q1.a:
On the main dashboard (Sessions), click the "+ New session" button. Fill in:

• Patient: pick an existing one or type the name freely
• Time (optional): to schedule it for the future
• WhatsApp/Email (optional): for automated confirmation and reminder

The platform generates a unique link for each session. You send it to the patient, and they join with one click at the scheduled time.

q2.q: How does my patient join the session?
q2.a:
The patient receives a unique link (via WhatsApp/email/manual copy). They:

1. Click the link at the scheduled time
2. Type their name (only on the first visit)
3. Allow camera/microphone in the browser
4. Enter the room — done

No sign-up, no app to download. Works on any modern browser (Chrome, Safari, Firefox, Edge).

q3.q: How do I enable automatic WhatsApp sending?
q3.a:
Open the WhatsApp page on the top menu. Turn on the "WhatsApp enabled" toggle and fill in your clinic/office name and contact phone.

The confirmation, reminder (24h before) and cancellation templates can be customized on the same page, with variables like {{paciente}}, {{data}}, {{hora}}.

Sending works through the platform's shared number (48988637670) — you don't need to pair your own WhatsApp.

q4.q: Can I issue a prescription for controlled medication?
q4.a:
Yes, if you're a physician (active CRM) or another professional authorized by law. Go to Prescriptions → "+ New prescription" → select the "Controlled" type.

The platform applies current Brazilian rules: 30-day validity (psychotropics B1, B2) or 60 days (A1, A2, A3 per the legislation), and includes the blue/yellow prescription pad fields depending on the substance.

The digital prescription is valid throughout Brazil under ANVISA's RDC 471/2021. The pharmacy verifies authenticity via the printed QR code.

q5.q: How do the trial and billing work?
q5.a:
You get 30 days free with full access to every feature. No card required to start.

After the trial, access is blocked until you subscribe to a plan:
• Professional: R$ 199/month
• Recent graduate (CRP/CRM less than 12 months old): R$ 99.50/month
• Student: free, upon submitting proof of enrollment in a higher-education program

Billing is recurring monthly via Mercado Pago. Cancel any time — you keep access until the end of the paid cycle.

q6.q: Is my data (and my patient's) secure?
q6.a:
Yes. We take this very seriously:

• End-to-end encryption: sensitive clinical data (notes, patient phone, medical records) is encrypted in your browser before upload. Even the server cannot read it.
• E2EE video: LiveKit with encryption, no one intercepts.
• LGPD (Brazil's data protection law): you are the data controller; we are the operator. Full policy at Privacy policy.
• Automatic backup: data is redundantly stored across multiple regions by Firestore.

q7.q: Why don't some features show up for me?
q7.a:
The platform respects the legal scope of each professional council. Each specialty sees only what it can issue:

• CRM (physicians): full prescription (OTC, controlled, supplies), medical note, all documents
• CRP (psychologists): psychological documents (psychological note, declaration, report), no prescription
• CREFITO (physiotherapy/OT): clinical documents, no prescription; subtype determines whether it appears as "Physiotherapy" or "OT"
• CRN (nutritionists): prescription for supplies (Law 8,234/91)
• CRO (dentists): dental prescription and medical note

If you think we're missing something you're legally entitled to issue, let us know.

q8.q: I forgot my password. How do I recover it?
q8.a:
On the login screen, click "Forgot my password". We'll send a link to your registered email.

Heads up: if you enabled the recovery key at sign-up (24 words), recovering the password does not restore access to the encrypted records — you need the key to read older data. If you lose both, the data becomes inaccessible (the trade-off of E2EE).

q9.q: How do I cancel my subscription?
q9.a:
Go to Profile → "Plan" section → "Manage plan". You're redirected to the Mercado Pago dashboard, where you can cancel the recurring charge.

After cancelling, you keep access until the end of the already-paid cycle. Data remains stored for 60 days, giving you time to reactivate or export it.

q10.q: Can I use the platform on a phone/tablet?
q10.a:
Yes — everything runs in the browser (Chrome on Android / Safari on iPhone). There's no app to download.

For telehealth sessions, we recommend a front camera + headphones to avoid echo. A stable Wi-Fi connection is better than 4G/5G.
